# reolink_recording (Resource)

Manages the Reolink recording enable switch and native alarm schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

variable "reolink_recording_schedule" {
  description = "Camera-native weekly recording schedule encoded as JSON."
  type        = string
}

resource "reolink_recording" "front" {
  camera   = "front"
  enabled  = true
  schedule = var.reolink_recording_schedule
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `camera` (String) Key in the provider cameras map.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether camera recording is enabled.
- `schedule` (String) Native JSON schedule object, preserving legacy and V20 alarm tables exactly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

terraform import reolink_recording.front front
```
